display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用冻结识别器置信度整包路由筛查
description: 同一逐包规则比较冻结默认头对 R17 与实增益恢复结果的最大 softmax 概率，选更高者并使用同一默认头预测；无新训练及阈值拟合。
authorization: 用户要求两个数据集使用通用融合方法，优先 R02/R07/R17；显存充足立即启动并保护其他 owner。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: same packetwise frozen-default-head confidence rule and native reader; LoRa 8192 and WiSig 256 input, separately sourced experts and frozen classifiers
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Classifier-guided inference: frozen default-head logits of the current packet are used for routing and the same default head scores the chosen recovered signal. No classifier-guided training, new model update, source V truth, target truth, cross-packet statistic or target fitting. LoRa expert has previously authorized E104-guided ancestry; WiSig gain expert is F-free. Classifier dependency and extra forward cost must be disclosed.

checkpoint.initialization: No new trained parameters. Reuse separately source-trained real-gain and R17 experts and the original matching frozen classifier/default head for each dataset.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed routing rule: select the expert with larger maximum softmax probability on the current packet; ties select R17. No threshold or model selected using target. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus all available controls; WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2. LoRa R69 architecture adaptation is distinct from original WiSig DURA v1.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [7,1,6,4], each >=8192 MiB free; excludes GPU 2 and 3 previously used by the source-contrastive run; preserve other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: same fixed per-packet maximum default-head softmax confidence routing of independently trained real-gain and R17 experts

data_overrides.training: none; inference reads frozen original classifier and two matched source-trained experts

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: zero new training updates; screening code performs six frozen default-head forwards per packet: two routing probes plus direct, two expert and selected-output predictions; fixed no-query smoke then source V prediction

notes: Same routing rule on both datasets; each uses its own contracted source-trained real-gain and R17 experts and frozen original default classifier. No new trainable parameters.

For each packet independently, compute each expert output and softmax over that dataset original frozen default-head logits; choose the whole output with the larger maximum probability, ties R17. No threshold, classifier update, truth, packet aggregation or target tuning.

The frozen classifier participates in inference and is also the evaluation classifier. This is explicitly classifier-guided inference, distinct from a classifier-independent restorer. Screening executes six classifier forwards per packet for routing plus all required controls; report screen cost and do not claim independence from the classifier.

Original LoRa real-gain expert has prior authorized E104 guidance and pseudolabels; WiSig real-gain expert is independently source-trained F-free. Frozen classifier weights and default heads are not modified.

Source V panels and prior results repeatedly exposed; target IQ and truth are not accessed in the screen. Fixed panel, matched controls and advancement rule were recorded before reading this candidate result.
